narrative.overview: Baytak records rent and building charges between a resident and the person who runs the building. The world it borrows is the paper receipt book: carbon-copy ink blue for the shell, cool paper for the ground, white slips for content, and rubber stamps for state. Payment status is the one authored moment. Layout, navigation and controls stay platform-standard so the world lends type, palette, density and the stamp. One shared look for iOS and Android, calm operational density, small crisp corners, light mode only. The whole app now sits in this world. Recorded from source only; finish review dispositions were recapture then fix (applied); device captures are owed.
keyCharacteristics: Ink blue carries the shell, primary buttons and door plates; text is tinted from the ink, never neutral gray.
Two stamp inks do the state jobs: verdigris is Paid, vermilion is Unpaid. State is always word plus icon, never colour alone.
One family (IBM Plex Sans Arabic), Latin and Arabic, with fixed-width digits for money and numbers.
Flat slips with a faint shadow; depth otherwise from paper-on-paper tone.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Verdigris means Paid and vermilion means Unpaid, everywhere, and neither is used for decoration. Amber means Pending.

rules.name: The Words Beside Colour Rule
rules.body: A state colour never stands alone: it travels with the word (Paid, Unpaid) and an icon.

rules.name: The Ink-Tinted Text Rule
rules.body: Text colours come from the ink hue (text, text-muted, text-faint); no neutral gray text.

rules.name: The Numerals Rule
rules.body: Money and apartment numbers use the numeral treatment (heaviest weight, tabular digits).

rules.name: The Capped Scale Rule
rules.body: All text honours system font scaling up to MAX_FONT_SCALE = 1.6 and no further, via maxFontSizeMultiplier in the shared Text and TextField.

rules.name: The Slip Rule
rules.body: Content sits on white slips with at most the small shadow; only transient layers (toast) take the lifted one.

rules.name: The Money Is Not a Stamp Rule
rules.body: Income and expense (Wallet) are not set in verdigris or vermilion; the Wallet balance sits on a calm white card. The stamp inks stay reserved for state.

dos: Do take every colour, space, radius and type role from theme.ts; add a token before adding a literal.
Do show payment state as a Stamp (word plus icon) and apartment numbers as a DoorPlate.
Do keep targets at least HIT (48px Android, 44px elsewhere) and primary controls at 52px.
Do use border-input for field and checkbox borders, and start/end (never left/right) in styles.
Do gate any new motion on Reduce Motion, as Stamp does.
Do use the Text component so the 1.6 font-scale cap applies.
Do use Ionicons through the shared components, with an accessibility label on icon-only controls.
donts: Don't use verdigris or vermilion for anything but Paid/Success and Unpaid/Error.
Don't signal state by colour alone.
Don't use neutral gray text, pill-shaped buttons or badges, or large radii; the world is small crisp corners.
Don't set money direction (income, expense) in the stamp inks.
Don't use brass for text; it is a decorative rim.
Don't invent a custom navigation or control pattern where the platform has one.
